svg.text: DELIVERABLE E: AUDIENCE-SPECIFIC OUTPUT PACK (10 MARKS)
Verified Outputs Tailored for Principal, Faculty Management, and Student Social Media
OUTPUT 1: ONE-PAGE PRINCIPAL'S BRIEF (EXECUTIVE BRIEFING FORMAT)
Executive Summary & Event Scope:
Campus Innovation Week concluded its 3-day programme with 480 registered students and 312 entry gate records (65.0% turnout ratio,
subject to IT deduplication). Financial stewardship was maintained: recorded expenses of ₹1,08,500 remained ₹11,500 under the approved
₹1,20,000 ceiling (90.42% utilisation). With ₹75,000 confirmed in sponsor transfers, net college outlay was ₹33,500.
Limitations & Reputational Risk Assessment:
• Participant Evaluation: 96 voluntary feedback submissions rated the event 4.1/5.0. This reflects motivated respondents only.
• Reputational Safeguard: Preliminary drafts containing the claim "70% employability improvement" and referencing "NPII-7" were paused.
Publishing unverified statistical claims exposes the institution to regulatory scrutiny and accreditation downgrades.
MANDATORY SECTION: WHAT WE CANNOT CONCLUDE
• We CANNOT conclude that employability improved by 70%. Zero post-event placement tracking data was collected.
• We CANNOT generalize the 4.1/5 rating to all 480 registrants; 69.23% of attendees did not complete feedback.
• We CANNOT cite the 'NeuroPrompt Integrity Index (NPII-7)' or 'AI Output Integrity Act 2024'; both are hallucinations.
Strategic Recommendations:
1) Authorize IT deduplication of gate logs. 2) Institute 60-day alumni placement survey. 3) Adopt formal 9-stage AI Governance SOP.
Sign-off: Event Coordinator [VERIFIED] | Finance Rep [VERIFIED] | Faculty Lead [VERIFIED] | Principal [APPROVED]
OUTPUT 2: FIVE-SLIDE PRESENTATION OUTLINE (FACULTY & MANAGEMENT)
SLIDE 1: Executive Overview & Attendance Metrics
• Core Message: Campus Innovation Week engaged student innovators across 3 focused tracks.
• Key Metrics: 480 registered; 312 gate entry records (65.0% ratio). [Caveat: Deduplication pending].
SLIDE 2: Financial Governance & Budget Performance
• Core Message: Disciplined fiscal management delivered event 9.58% below budget cap.
• Key Metrics: Approved: ₹1,20,000 | Spent: ₹1,08,500 | Balance: ₹11,500 | Sponsor: ₹75,000 | Net Cost: ₹33,500.
SLIDE 3: Participant Feedback & Evaluation Boundaries
• Core Message: High satisfaction among respondents, bounded by sample size.
• Key Metrics: 96 voluntary submissions (30.77% response rate) rated event 4.1/5.0 stars.
SLIDE 4: Methodological Integrity: What We Cannot Conclude
• ❌ 70% Employability claim rejected as unsubstantiated rumor. Zero career tracer data exists.
• ❌ NPII-7 & AI Output Integrity Act 2024 removed as synthetic LLM confabulations.
SLIDE 5: Strategic Next Steps & Governance Roadmap
• 1) Complete barcode deduplication. 2) Deploy 60-day placement audit. 3) Enforce multi-sign-off AI workflow.
OUTPUT 3: PUBLIC SOCIAL-MEDIA POST (STUDENTS & COMMUNITY CHANNELS)
🚀 That’s a wrap on Campus Innovation Week!
Over 3 intense days of ideation, rapid prototyping, and hands-on workshops, our student community brought
incredible creativity and forward-thinking energy to the campus! Here is what we accomplished together:
• ⚡ 480 Students registered to build practical skills in cutting-edge emerging technologies
• ⚡ 312 Workshop Entries logged across three dynamic technical tracks
• ⚡ 4.1 / 5.0 Rating from our student feedback respondents!
Huge thanks to our faculty mentors, student volunteers, and our generous industry sponsors for powering this event.
#CampusInnovation #StudentBuilders #HandsOnTech #ResponsibleAI #InnovationWeek2026
Audit Note: 100% verified facts. Strictly zero unmeasured employability promises or buzzwords.
